question: Approve the folded ideation design — install sibling-uninstall fix plus the README posture (b) edge-channel label — and rule on keeping or dropping the separable AC-5 contractlint drift arm?

artifacts.summary: Folded design per captain ruling (no doc-only task). Install half unchanged from briefing-1: one tolerated sibling-uninstall step at position 2 mirroring codex, doctor split out to filed follow-up, seven-item live spike, value AC counts enabled spacedock@* entries in claude's own plugin list (2 today -> 1). README half folded from the superseded task: posture (b) diff (stable label + install-guide pointer, tap token normalized), AC-4 value baseline re-verified against the working tree, README spike evidence carried with its honest limit. Combined estimate net +167 across 8 files, tolerance ±55/±1 (subtotals +130/6 install, +37/2 README); alternate baseline net +137/7 if AC-5 drops. Fold consequences surfaced: the README half loses its small-change fast path (whole deliverable now carries full validation + detached adversarial audit, front-door surface); mkdocs strict build does not cover README.md, so AC-5's drift arm is the README's only mechanical guard — sharpening but not settling the necessity question. claude-live not required; detached audit required on both triggers, scoped at the install half.
